findings.finding: 517 randomized: 258 aficamten / 259 placebo; one placebo participant never dosed.
findings.limitation: Supports a possible randomized-versus-exposed distinction; does not authenticate complete FAS/safety populations, CONSORT Fig S2, site exclusions or per-table analysis denominators.

findings.limitation: Retain secondary 14(2.7%) as a distinct unresolved claim. No correction, replacement, pooled denominator, or clinical safety verdict is authorized by this accepted manuscript alone.
